name: The Lost Supplies
summary: A barrel bound for Nethergarde Keep bears Quartermaster Lungertz’s name.

sections.title: A Stamped Barrel
sections.body: Pungent yellow wax seals the seams of a small, sturdy barrel. Its base carries a stamp naming Quartermaster Lungertz and Nethergarde Keep, marking where it belongs.

sections.title: Word from the Quartermaster
sections.body: Quartermaster Lungertz thanks you for the recovered supplies. They often go astray on the road from Darkshire to Nethergarde. Some have now been found.

faq.q: Who is meant to receive the lost supplies?
faq.answer: The barrel is marked for Quartermaster Lungertz at Nethergarde Keep.

faq.q: How can you tell who owns the barrel?
faq.answer: A stamp on the barrel’s base names Quartermaster Lungertz and Nethergarde Keep.

faq.q: What does the barrel look like?
faq.answer: It is a small, sturdy barrel with pungent yellow wax sealing its seams.
